concept: Athena + Glue Data Catalog: serverless SQL on data in S3
tests: Choosing a serverless way to run ad-hoc SQL queries on files in S3 without loading them into a DB.
expected: Amazon Athena + AWS Glue Data Catalog (table schemas). Triggers: "ad-hoc SQL", "directly on files in S3", "serverless", "no loading into a database".
why_not: Redshift and RDS require loading data; EMR with Hive is a cluster you must provision and administer.
